articles.title: Claude Opus 5 became downright ruthless when tasked with running a vending machine
articles.description: Andon Labs' latest vending machine simulation shows Opus 5 lied and colluded its way to become the best AI capitalist ever.

articles.title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
articles.description: Rather than competing directly with faster chains, some builders argue Ethereum's strength lies in supporting the layer-2 networks where trading is taking place.

articles.title: Fed holds rates steady, extending pause as markets await Kevin Warsh's policy roadmap
articles.description: For the first time in several years, markets were somewhat split on whether the U.S. central bank would hike rates.

articles.description: New commodity options let traders gain exposure to gold and silver prices through Binance’s Abu Dhabi-regulated exchange.

articles.title: Bitcoin price wedged into ‘most divided’ FOMC as Iran war spikes oil prices 8%
articles.description: Bitcoin traders weathered an oil-price surge and ongoing Asia chip-stock sell-off into the Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

articles.title: Google brings its age-assurance technology to Android developers worldwide
articles.description: Google is expanding its Play Age Signals API, giving Android developers a privacy-preserving way to tailor experiences based on users’ age ranges.

articles.title: MoonPay vault enables ChatGPT and Claude users to authorize crypto transactions
articles.description: MoonPay’s PayBox vault lets ChatGPT and Claude users authorize crypto purchases, token swaps and crosschain transactions while retaining custody of their assets.

articles.title: The traditional 9-to-5 banking day is officially dying, says Morgan Stanley execs
articles.description: Tokenization and 24/7 markets are reshaping finance, making always-on banking a reality.

articles.title: Cost to insure AI debt reaches record high amid Asian semiconductor tumble
articles.description: Seoul’s historic two-day crash and widening hyperscaler credit spreads suggest the AI trade’s leverage is starting to bite — in equities and in bonds.

articles.description: X sued the WFA in 2024 for conducting what it called a "systematic illegal boycott" of the platform after it saw a decline in advertising revenue following Musk's $44 billion takeover of the social network.

articles.title: Hint, a new AI startup co-founded by Martha Stewart, offers an AI assistant for homeowners
articles.description: AI home management startup Hint, co-founded by Martha Stewart, wants to become an “AI for your home,” combining property records, maintenance schedules, home documents, and an AI assistant into a single app.

articles.title: Stablecoin firm Brale says new protocol can remove a major hurdle to scaling custom tokens
articles.description: Today's bridge model won't scale as hundreds of companies issue their own stablecoins, fragmenting liquidity, Brale CEO Ben Milne said in an interview.

articles.title: Coinbase hit by spot trading slump: Wall Street trims expectations ahead of earnings

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What this year's $972 million crypto hacks actually tell us about security
articles.description: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Immunefi's Mitchell Amador writes that most of 2026's stolen crypto is leaving through keys, signers and governance, not contract bugs, and explains why “we were audited” was never the same as “we are safe.”

articles.title: Perplexity employee who worked on Comet launches an AI browser aimed at knowledge work
articles.description: Polar has come out with an AI-first browser aimed at knowledge workers, and it has now raised a $5.7 million seed round led by Madrona.

articles.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.description: The startup analyzes calls, messages, and CRM data to identify effective sales techniques and turn them into playbooks for AI agents.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation names pcaversaccio to board amid leadership changes
articles.description: pcaversaccio (known as "pc"), is a prominent security researcher in the Ethereum ecosystem. His addition brings the foundation's board to four members.
